dmg2024EncounterBudgets.description: 2024 DMG XP Budget per character by level. Sum the budgets for all characters in the party and spend directly on raw monster XP (no monster-count multipliers).

Very Easy.guideline: Almost anyone can do this without training; noticing something large in plain sight.

Easy.guideline: Routine task for an adventurer; climbing a knotted rope, recalling common local lore.

Medium.guideline: Requires training or natural talent; picking a standard lock, spotting a well-hidden tripwire.

Hard.guideline: Challenging even for experts; swimming against a raging underground river, disarming an arcane glyph.

Very Hard.guideline: Heroic feat; picking a masterwork dwarven vault, tracking a creature across bare rain-washed stone.

Nearly Impossible.guideline: Legendary mastery required; persuading a hostile warlord to stand down mid-siege.

examples: Hit by falling rubble in a collapsing tunnel
Tumbling into a vat of acid
Hit by a crashing flying fortress
Tumbling into a vortex of fire on the Elemental Plane of Fire
Crushed in the jaws of a godlike monster

Acrobatics.description: Stay on your feet in a tricky situation, balance on a tightrope or icy ledge, perform acrobatic stunts, or escape a grapple.

Animal Handling.description: Calm down a domesticated animal, keep a mount from getting spooked, or intuit an animal's intentions.

Arcana.description: Recall lore about spells, eldritch symbols, magical traditions, the planes of existence, and the inhabitants of those planes.

Athletics.description: Climb a sheer or slippery cliff, jump an unusually long distance, swim in treacherous currents, or grapple/shove a creature.

Deception.description: Convincingly hide the truth, either verbally or through your actions, fast-talk a guard, or maintain a disguise.

History.description: Recall lore about historical events, legendary people, ancient kingdoms, past disputes, recent wars, and lost civilizations.

Insight.description: Determine the true intentions of a creature, such as when searching out a lie or predicting someone's next move from body language.

Intimidation.description: Attempt to influence someone through overt threats, hostile actions, and physical violence.

Investigation.description: Look around for clues and make deductions based on those clues, deduce the location of a hidden object, or discern how a trap works.

Medicine.description: Try to stabilize a dying companion (DC 10) or diagnose an illness, poison, or cause of death.

Nature.description: Recall lore about terrain, plants and animals, the weather, and natural cycles.

Perception.description: Spot, hear, or otherwise detect the presence of something; measures general awareness of your surroundings and keenness of senses.

Performance.description: Delight an audience with music, dance, acting, storytelling, or some other form of entertainment.

Persuasion.description: Influence someone or a group of people with tact, social graces, or good nature; act in good faith to foster friendships or negotiate peace.

Religion.description: Recall lore about deities, rites and prayers, religious hierarchies, holy symbols, undead ecology, and the practices of secret cults.

Sleight of Hand.description: Attempt an act of legerdemain or manual trickery, such as planting something on someone else, concealing an object, or picking a pocket.

Stealth.description: Attempt to conceal yourself from enemies, slink past guards, slip away without being noticed, or sneak up on someone without being seen or heard.

Survival.description: Follow tracks, hunt wild game, guide your group through frozen wastelands, identify signs of nearby creatures, or avoid natural hazards.

Blinded.name: Blinded
effects: Automatically fails any ability check that requires sight.
Attack rolls against the creature have Advantage.
The creature's attack rolls have Disadvantage.

Charmed.name: Charmed
effects: Can't attack the charmer or target the charmer with harmful abilities or magical effects.
The charmer has Advantage on any ability check to interact socially with the creature.

Deafened.name: Deafened
effects: Automatically fails any ability check that requires hearing.

Exhaustion.name: Exhaustion
effects: Level 1: Disadvantage on ability checks.
Level 2: Speed halved.
Level 3: Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws.
Level 4: Hit point maximum halved.
Level 5: Speed reduced to 0.
Level 6: Death.

Frightened.name: Frightened
effects: Has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of its fear is within line of sight.
The creature can't willingly move closer to the source of its fear.

Grappled.name: Grappled
effects: A grappled creature's speed becomes 0, and it can't benefit from any bonus to its speed.
The condition ends if the grappler is Incapacitated or if an effect removes the grappled creature from the reach of the grappler.

Incapacitated.name: Incapacitated
effects: An incapacitated creature can't take Actions or Reactions.
Immediately loses Concentration on any spell.

Invisible.name: Invisible
effects: Impossible to see without the aid of magic or a special sense (counts as Heavily Obscured for hiding).
Attack rolls against the creature have Disadvantage.
The creature's attack rolls have Advantage.

Paralyzed.name: Paralyzed
effects: Is Incapacitated and can't move or speak.
Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Attack rolls against the creature have Advantage.
Any attack that hits the creature is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of the creature.

Petrified.name: Petrified
effects: Transformed, along with any nonmagical object it is wearing or carrying, into a solid inanimate substance (usually stone); weight increases by a factor of 10.
Is Incapacitated, can't move or speak, and is unaware of its surroundings.
Attack rolls against the creature have Advantage.
Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Has Resistance to all damage, and is Immune to poison and disease.

Poisoned.name: Poisoned
effects: A poisoned creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

Prone.name: Prone
effects: Only movement option is to crawl, unless it stands up (spending half its movement speed).
The creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls.
An attack roll against the creature has Advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet, otherwise the attack roll has Disadvantage.

Restrained.name: Restrained
effects: A restrained creature's speed becomes 0, and it can't benefit from any bonus to its speed.
Attack rolls against the creature have Advantage, and the creature's attack rolls have Disadvantage.
The creature has Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

Stunned.name: Stunned
effects: Is Incapacitated, can't move, and can speak only falteringly.
Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Attack rolls against the creature have Advantage.

Unconscious.name: Unconscious
effects: Is Incapacitated, can't move or speak, and is unaware of its surroundings.
Drops whatever it's holding and falls Prone.
Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Attack rolls against the creature have Advantage.
Any attack that hits the creature is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of the creature.

Friendly.behavior: Wishes the party well; offers help, information, or fair bargains if risk is low.

Indifferent.behavior: Neutral or self-interested; cares about their own safety, coin, or duty.

Hostile.behavior: Opposes the party; seeks to thwart, deceive, drive off, or attack them.

Arcana.description: Magical knowledge and mysticism: gemstones, spell scrolls, potions, wands, staffs, rings, and wondrous items.

Armaments.description: Martial war-gear: coins, trade bars, +1/+2/+3 weapons, shields, armor, and magical ammunition.

sampleValuables: Masterwork dwarven whetstone and scabbard (50 GP)
Royal treasury chests of platinum and rubies

Implements.description: Adventuring tools and utility: coins, mundane gear, thieves' tools, bags of holding, boots, cloaks, and utility magic items.

Planar trade charters and astral diamonds

Relics.description: Sacred, ancient, or cursed artifacts: art objects, holy symbols, divine scrolls, censers, and relic magic items.

Vials of Holy Water (25 GP each)

Sacred astral vestments and divine regalia

races.name: Dwarf
traits: Dwarven Resilience (Advantage on saving throws against poison, Resistance against poison damage)
Dwarven Combat Training (Proficiency with battleaxe, handaxe, light hammer, warhammer)
Tool Proficiency (Smith's tools, brewer's supplies, or mason's tools)
Stonecunning (Double proficiency bonus on INT [History] checks related to the origin of stonework)

subraces.name: Hill Dwarf
traits: Dwarven Toughness (+1 HP maximum per level)

subraces.name: Mountain Dwarf
traits: Dwarven Armor Training (Proficiency with light and medium armor)

races.name: Elf
traits: Keen Senses (Proficiency in Perception)
Fey Ancestry (Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed; magic can't put you to sleep)
Trance (4 hours of meditation grants the benefit of an 8-hour Long Rest)

subraces.name: High Elf
traits: Elf Weapon Training (Longsword, shortsword, shortbow, longbow)
Cantrip (One Wizard cantrip using INT)
Extra Language (One additional language of choice)

subraces.name: Wood Elf
traits: Elf Weapon Training (Longsword, shortsword, shortbow, longbow)
Fleet of Foot (Base walking speed increases to 35 ft.)
Mask of the Wild (Can attempt to Hide when only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena)

subraces.name: Dark Elf (Drow)
traits: Sunlight Sensitivity (Disadvantage on attack rolls and sight-based Perception checks in direct sunlight)
Drow Magic (Dancing Lights cantrip; Faerie Fire at L3; Darkness at L5, using CHA)
Drow Weapon Training (Rapiers, shortswords, hand crossbows)

races.name: Halfling
traits: Lucky (When you roll a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll)
Brave (Advantage on saving throws against being Frightened)
Halfling Nimbleness (Can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours)

subraces.name: Lightfoot Halfling
traits: Naturally Stealthy (Can attempt to Hide even when obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you)

subraces.name: Stout Halfling
traits: Stout Resilience (Advantage on saving throws against poison, and Resistance against poison damage)

races.name: Human
traits: Versatile Heritage (+1 to all six ability scores)

subraces.name: Standard Human
traits: +1 to all six ability scores

subraces.name: Variant Human
traits: +1 to two different ability scores of choice
Skills (Proficiency in one skill of choice)
Feat (Gain one Feat of choice at Level 1)

races.name: Dragonborn
traits: Draconic Ancestry (Choose Black/Copper [Acid], Blue/Bronze [Lightning], Brass/Gold/Red [Fire], Green [Poison], or Silver/White [Cold])
Breath Weapon (Action, 1/Short or Long Rest: 15-ft cone or 5x30-ft line, DC 8 + CON mod + PB, 2d6 elemental damage [3d6 at L6, 4d6 at L11, 5d6 at L16], half on save)
Damage Resistance (Resistance to the damage type associated with your Draconic Ancestry)

races.name: Gnome
traits: Gnome Cunning (Advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic)

subraces.name: Forest Gnome
traits: Natural Illusionist (Minor Illusion cantrip using INT)
Speak with Small Beasts (Communicate simple ideas with Small or smaller beasts)

subraces.name: Rock Gnome
traits: Artificer's Lore (Double proficiency bonus on INT [History] checks related to magic items, alchemical objects, or technological devices)
Tinker (Proficiency with tinker's tools; construct tiny clockwork devices)

races.name: Half-Elf
traits: Fey Ancestry (Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed; magic can't put you to sleep)
Skill Versatility (Gain proficiency in two skills of your choice)

races.name: Half-Orc
traits: Menacing (Proficiency in the Intimidation skill)
Relentless Endurance (1/Long Rest: When reduced to 0 HP but not killed outright, drop to 1 HP instead)
Savage Attacks (When you score a Critical Hit with a melee weapon attack, roll one of the weapon's damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage)

races.name: Tiefling
traits: Hellish Resistance (Resistance to Fire damage)
Infernal Legacy (Thaumaturgy cantrip; Hellish Rebuke as a 2nd-level spell 1/Long Rest at L3; Darkness 1/Long Rest at L5, using CHA)

coreFeatures.name: Rage
coreFeatures.description: Bonus Action (2/Long Rest at L1, 3 at L3): Advantage on STR checks and STR saves, +2 melee damage using STR, and Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage for 1 minute.

coreFeatures.name: Unarmored Defense
coreFeatures.description: While not wearing armor, AC = 10 + DEX mod + CON mod (can use a shield).

coreFeatures.name: Reckless Attack
coreFeatures.description: Gain Advantage on melee weapon attack rolls using STR this turn, but attack rolls against you have Advantage until your next turn.

coreFeatures.name: Danger Sense
coreFeatures.description: Advantage on DEX saving throws against effects you can see (such as traps and spells).

coreFeatures.name: Primal Path
coreFeatures.description: Choose a subclass (e.g., Path of the Berserker or Path of the Totem Warrior).

coreFeatures.name: Extra Attack & Fast Movement
coreFeatures.description: Attack twice when taking the Attack action; speed increases by +10 ft. while not wearing heavy armor.

coreFeatures.name: Bardic Inspiration
coreFeatures.description: Bonus Action (CHA mod times per Long Rest; Short Rest at L5+): Grant one creature within 60 ft. a d6 Inspiration die (d8 at L5, d10 at L10, d12 at L15) to add to an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw.

coreFeatures.name: Jack of All Trades
coreFeatures.description: Add half your Proficiency Bonus (rounded down) to any ability check you make that doesn't already include your PB.

coreFeatures.name: Song of Rest
coreFeatures.description: Allies spending Hit Dice during a Short Rest regain an extra 1d6 HP.

coreFeatures.name: Bard College & Expertise
coreFeatures.description: Choose a subclass (e.g., College of Lore or College of Valor) and double PB for two chosen skill proficiencies.

coreFeatures.name: Font of Inspiration
coreFeatures.description: Regain all expended uses of Bardic Inspiration on a Short or Long Rest; die upgrades to d8.

coreFeatures.name: Divine Domain
coreFeatures.description: Choose a domain (e.g., Life, Light, Trickery, Knowledge, Tempest, War) granting always-prepared domain spells and bonus proficiencies.

coreFeatures.name: Channel Divinity (1/Short Rest)
coreFeatures.description: Turn Undead (Action: Each Undead within 30 ft. must make a WIS save or be Turned for 1 minute) or use your Domain's Channel Divinity option.

coreFeatures.name: Destroy Undead (CR 1/2)
coreFeatures.description: Undead of CR 1/2 or lower that fail their saving throw against your Turn Undead are instantly destroyed.

coreFeatures.name: Druidic
coreFeatures.description: Know the secret language of druids and leave hidden nature symbols.

coreFeatures.name: Wild Shape (2/Short Rest)
coreFeatures.description: Magically assume the shape of a Beast you have seen before (Action, or Bonus Action for Circle of the Moon).

coreFeatures.name: Druid Circle
coreFeatures.description: Choose a subclass (e.g., Circle of the Land or Circle of the Moon).

coreFeatures.name: Fighting Style
coreFeatures.description: Choose Archery (+2 ranged attack rolls), Defense (+1 AC in armor), Dueling (+2 melee damage with 1H weapon), Great Weapon Fighting, Protection, or Two-Weapon Fighting.

coreFeatures.name: Second Wind (1/Short Rest)
coreFeatures.description: Bonus Action: Regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 + Fighter level.

coreFeatures.name: Action Surge (1/Short Rest)
coreFeatures.description: On your turn, take one additional Action on top of your regular Action and a possible Bonus Action.

coreFeatures.name: Martial Archetype
coreFeatures.description: Choose Champion (Improved Critical 19-20), Battle Master (4 Superiority Dice d8 & Maneuvers), or Eldritch Knight (Arcane spellcasting).

coreFeatures.name: Extra Attack
coreFeatures.description: Attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn (3 times at L11, 4 times at L20).

coreFeatures.name: Unarmored Defense
coreFeatures.description: While wearing no armor and not wielding a shield, AC = 10 + DEX mod + WIS mod.

coreFeatures.name: Martial Arts
coreFeatures.description: Use DEX instead of STR for unarmed strikes and monk weapons; roll d4 (d6 at L5, d8 at L11, d10 at L17) for unarmed damage; make 1 unarmed strike as a Bonus Action after attacking.

coreFeatures.name: Ki (Recharges on Short Rest)
coreFeatures.description: Spend Ki Points (equal to Monk level) for Flurry of Blows (2 unarmed strikes as Bonus Action), Patient Defense (Dodge as Bonus Action), or Step of the Wind (Dash/Disengage as Bonus Action).

coreFeatures.name: Monastic Tradition & Deflect Missiles
coreFeatures.description: Choose Way of the Open Hand, Way of Shadow, or Way of the Four Elements; use Reaction to reduce ranged weapon damage by 1d10 + DEX mod + Monk level.

coreFeatures.name: Extra Attack & Stunning Strike
coreFeatures.description: Attack twice per Attack action; spend 1 Ki Point on hit to force CON save (DC 8 + PB + WIS mod) or target is Stunned until the end of your next turn.

coreFeatures.name: Divine Sense & Lay on Hands
coreFeatures.description: Detect Celestials, Fiends, and Undead within 60 ft.; healing pool of (Paladin level * 5) HP that restores HP or cures 1 disease/poison for 5 HP.

coreFeatures.name: Fighting Style, Spellcasting & Divine Smite
coreFeatures.description: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, expend one spell slot to deal an extra 2d8 Radiant damage (+1d8 per slot level above 1st, +1d8 vs. Undead or Fiends).

coreFeatures.name: Sacred Oath & Divine Health
coreFeatures.description: Immune to disease; swear Oath of Devotion, Oath of the Ancients, or Oath of Vengeance (granting Channel Divinity).

coreFeatures.name: Extra Attack
coreFeatures.description: Attack twice whenever you take the Attack action.

coreFeatures.name: Aura of Protection
coreFeatures.description: You and friendly creatures within 10 ft. gain a bonus to all saving throws equal to your CHA modifier (minimum +1).

coreFeatures.name: Favored Enemy & Natural Explorer
coreFeatures.description: Advantage on Survival checks to track and INT checks to recall lore about favored enemies; expertise and travel benefits in favored terrain.

coreFeatures.name: Fighting Style & Spellcasting
coreFeatures.description: Gain Fighting Style and Ranger spells (such as Hunter's Mark and Cure Wounds).

coreFeatures.name: Ranger Archetype
coreFeatures.description: Choose Hunter (Colossus Slayer +1d8 damage once per turn against wounded foes) or Beast Master.

coreFeatures.name: Extra Attack
coreFeatures.description: Attack twice whenever you take the Attack action.

coreFeatures.name: Expertise, Sneak Attack & Thieves' Cant
coreFeatures.description: Double PB for two skills/thieves' tools; once per turn deal extra 1d6 damage (2d6 at L3, 3d6 at L5, up to 10d6 at L19) with a Finesse or Ranged weapon if you have Advantage or an ally is within 5 ft. of the target.

coreFeatures.name: Cunning Action
coreFeatures.description: Take a Bonus Action on each of your turns in combat to Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

coreFeatures.name: Roguish Archetype
coreFeatures.description: Choose Thief (Fast Hands, Second-Story Work), Assassin (Assassinate), or Arcane Trickster (Mage Hand Legerdemain & spells).

coreFeatures.name: Uncanny Dodge
coreFeatures.description: Reaction: When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack, halve the attack's damage against you.

coreFeatures.name: Evasion
coreFeatures.description: Take 0 damage on a successful DEX save against half-damage AoE effects, and only half damage on a failed save.

coreFeatures.name: Sorcerous Origin
coreFeatures.description: Choose Draconic Bloodline (Base AC 13 + DEX mod, +1 HP per level, elemental affinity) or Wild Magic (Tides of Chaos & Wild Magic Surge).

coreFeatures.name: Font of Magic
coreFeatures.description: Gain Sorcery Points equal to Sorcerer level; convert Sorcery Points to Spell Slots and vice versa as a Bonus Action.

coreFeatures.name: Metamagic
coreFeatures.description: Twist spells using Sorcery Points: Careful Spell, Distant Spell, Empowered Spell, Extended Spell, Heightened Spell, Quickened Spell, Subtle Spell, or Twinned Spell.

coreFeatures.name: Otherworldly Patron & Pact Magic
coreFeatures.description: Forge a pact with The Archfey, The Fiend (Dark One's Blessing temp HP on kill), or The Great Old One; Pact Magic slots always cast at highest available slot level and recharge on a Short Rest.

coreFeatures.name: Eldritch Invocations
coreFeatures.description: Learn permanent arcane augmentations such as Agonizing Blast (+CHA mod to Eldritch Blast damage), Devil's Sight (120 ft. magical darkvision), or Mask of Many Faces (Disguise Self at will).

coreFeatures.name: Pact Boon
coreFeatures.description: Choose Pact of the Chain (upgraded Familiar), Pact of the Blade (summon magical pact weapon), or Pact of the Tome (Book of Shadows cantrips/rituals).

coreFeatures.name: Spellbook & Arcane Recovery
coreFeatures.description: Maintain a spellbook (cast any ritual spell in your book without preparing it); 1/Day on a Short Rest recover spell slots with combined level up to ceil(Wizard level / 2).

coreFeatures.name: Arcane Tradition
coreFeatures.description: Specialize in one of the 8 Schools of Magic: Abjuration (Arcane Ward), Evocation (Sculpt Spells to protect allies from AoE), Divination (Portent 2d20 rolls), Necromancy, Conjuration, Enchantment, Illusion, or Transmutation.
